title: Wikimedia Commons CC/PD video pool (ORVEX selection)
creator: Wikimedia Commons contributors (per-file author)
license_terms: Per file (machine-readable): CC0 / Public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA only; NC, ND and unknown rejected
license_evidence_url: Commons API extmetadata LicenseShortName per file
real_world_eligibility: Eligible: real user-uploaded recordings; selection is ORVEX's own query-based sample, not a published benchmark
media_origin_characterization: User-uploaded real-world video (speeches, street, wildlife, sport, music, science...)
inclusion_reason: Only surveyed source with real media bytes whose per-file licence permits storage, transformation and redistribution with attribution; used as source pool for controlled variants.
tasks_supported: Phase1: controlled variants, relationship ground truth, feature extraction; Phase2: local-corpus connector, real upload observations
limitations: Not a benchmark; no native relationship labels; themes chosen by ORVEX queries; per-file licence re-check needed before public release; Commons 'Public domain' can be jurisdiction-specific

title: ANAKIN: manipulated videos and mask annotations (incl. VideoSham edited videos)
creator: Black et al. (AlexBlck)
bytes_or_urls_provided: media_bytes (edited, trimmed, masks, full) + metadata.csv with Vimeo URLs
real_world_eligibility: Eligible as real-world human-edited evaluation data (professional editors edited real Vimeo clips under assigned tasks); NOT naturally circulating posts
native_labels: manipulation-type (splicing, inpainting, swap, audio, frame-level), task text, editor-id, trim start/end, masks
media_origin_characterization: Real videos edited by human editors; edit pairs documented by the authors
inclusion_reason: Only open set with real source->edited video pairs and edit types. Stratified subset of trimmed+edited(+masks) downloaded; 'full' videos (44.6 GB) excluded_over_budget. Used for native edit relations/evaluation, NOT as source for controlled variants (conservative: underlying Vimeo rights).
limitations: Editors were commissioned (not wild reposts); Vimeo source rights unverified; subset only

title: InVID Fake Video Corpus 2018 (v3)
creator: Papadopoulou, Zampoglou, Papadopoulos, Kompatsiaris
real_world_eligibility: Eligible: naturally circulating debunked/verified user-generated videos and their near-duplicate reposts (cascades)
native_labels: label fake/real per URL, cascade_id; near-duplicates temporally ordered in cascades
media_origin_characterization: Videos circulating on YouTube, Facebook, Twitter
auth_required: none for metadata; media must be fetched from platforms under their terms
inclusion_reason: Real-world repost cascades with fake/real labels; media bytes are not provided (authors do not own rights) so records stay metadata_only; no third-party downloader used.
tasks_supported: Modules 3,6,7 (repost cascades, authenticity/misleading labels); evaluation metadata
limitations: URLs may be dead; no timestamps in the CSV (order within cascade only); label 'fake' means debunked, not AI-generated

title: InVID Fake Video Corpus v2.0
creator: Papadopoulou et al.
real_world_eligibility: Eligible (naturally circulating debunked/real videos)
native_labels: Type of Manipulation, Discussed, Appeared, Timestamp (tamper time)
overlap_with: RW-03, RW-05 (overlap measured by URL in duplicate_map)
inclusion_reason: Adds native fields not in 2018 CSV (type of manipulation, debunk URLs, tamper timestamp); overlapping records are mapped, not double counted.

title: InVID Fake Video Corpus v1.0
creator: Papadopoulos, Zampoglou, Kompatsiaris, Teyssou
real_world_eligibility: Eligible (verified fakes)
inclusion_reason: Earlier version (59 entries) superseded by later versions; records kept in media master only to map duplicates (not counted twice).
limitations: Authors state it is not meant for quantitative evaluation

title: InVID FIVR-200K (Fine-grained Incident Video Retrieval)
creator: Kordopatis-Zilos, Papadopoulos, Patras, Kompatsiaris
real_world_eligibility: Eligible: YouTube videos from real news events
native_labels: ND near-duplicate, DS duplicate scene (same camera), CS complementary scene (different camera), IS incident scene (implicit via event)
media_origin_characterization: User/news videos on YouTube grouped by Wikipedia news events
inclusion_reason: Native related-scene vs copy labels (needed to separate same-event from derivation); 225,960 YouTube ids + 100 query annotations. Media bytes not provided.
limitations: Same-incident labels are NOT derivation labels; videos not downloaded

title: VCSL (Video Copy Segment Localization)
creator: He et al. (Ant Group)
license_terms: Code: MIT. Dataset licence: not stated in README/LICENSE
real_world_eligibility: Eligible: real YouTube/Bilibili videos with human-annotated copy segments
native_labels: label_file_uuid_total.json (segment start/end pairs), pair files, categories
media_origin_characterization: Videos on YouTube (1,554 urls) and Bilibili (7,653 urls)
inclusion_reason: Best real segment-level copy annotations; media rights not cleared, dataset licence not stated, so only annotations and URLs are used; no third-party downloader used.
limitations: Some links dead; segment units assumed seconds (1 fps sampling per README); media rights unresolved

title: VCDB (Video Copy Detection Benchmark)
creator: Jiang, Jiang, Wang
real_world_eligibility: Likely eligible (web videos) but unverified
inclusion_reason: Official Fudan page failed TLS certificate validation (not bypassed); the suggested GitHub lead (ccny-zhangx/VCDB) returned 404 on 2026-10-26.

title: A corpus of debunked and verified user-generated videos (journal paper record)
creator: Papadopoulou et al.
real_world_eligibility: n/a (paper)
inclusion_reason: Describes the same corpus as RW-03; contains only the article PDF (380 videos, 5,195 near-duplicates).

title: WildDeepfake
creator: Zi et al.
real_world_eligibility: Internet-collected deepfakes (naturally circulating) but provenance/terms unverified; authenticity task, not lineage
media_origin_characterization: 707 deepfake videos collected from the internet
inclusion_reason: Optional authenticity benchmark only; terms and provenance not verified; must not substitute for a lineage dataset.

title: DFDC (DeepFake Detection Challenge) dataset
creator: Dolhansky et al. (Facebook AI)
real_world_eligibility: NOT eligible: >100,000 clips recorded by 3,426 paid actors and manipulated by the challenge organisers (research-created)
inclusion_reason: Research-generated manipulation dataset; excluded from the naturally-circulating collection per project rule.

title: FaceForensics++
creator: Rossler et al.
real_world_eligibility: NOT eligible: manipulations generated by the authors with DeepFakes/Face2Face/FaceSwap/NeuralTextures
inclusion_reason: Research-created fakes; not naturally circulating.

title: Celeb-DF / Celeb-DF++
creator: Li et al.
real_world_eligibility: NOT eligible: DeepFakes synthesised by the authors
inclusion_reason: Research-created deepfakes.

title: FakeAVCeleb
creator: Khalid et al.
license_terms: Request form; link sent after acceptance
real_world_eligibility: NOT eligible: synthetic faces and cloned voices created by the authors
inclusion_reason: Contains AI-generated audio/video; violates the no-synthetic-audio rule.

title: AV-Deepfake1M
creator: Cai et al.
real_world_eligibility: NOT eligible: LLM-driven synthetic manipulations
inclusion_reason: Synthetic content.

title: Deepfake-Eval-2024
creator: Chandra et al.
real_world_eligibility: In-the-wild circulated suspected deepfakes (2024); access and terms unverified
media_origin_characterization: Content flagged by users on social media
inclusion_reason: Authenticity benchmark, optional; access not verified.

title: VSC 2022/2023 Video Similarity Challenge dataset
creator: Pizzi et al. (Meta)
license_terms: Built from YFCC100M videos with CC licences allowing derivatives (paper); release terms not read
real_world_eligibility: Real videos with organiser-made edits; audio removed
media_origin_characterization: CC Flickr videos with synthetic edits by organisers
inclusion_reason: Terms/access not verified; audio removed so unusable for audio evidence.

title: YFCC100M (video subset)
creator: Thomee et al.
license_terms: Per-item CC licence; metadata under Yahoo Webscope data-sharing agreement
real_world_eligibility: Real Flickr videos
inclusion_reason: Requires a signed Webscope agreement; current distribution route not verified.

title: CC_WEB_VIDEO
creator: Wu et al.
real_world_eligibility: Web videos (likely eligible) but unverified
inclusion_reason: Official page not reached.

title: SVD (Short Video Dataset)
creator: Jiang et al.
real_world_eligibility: Real short videos, unverified
inclusion_reason: Terms/access not verified.

title: NIST Nimble / Media Forensics Challenge data
creator: NIST
real_world_eligibility: Evaluation corpora with organiser-created manipulations (images/video); provenance graphs
inclusion_reason: Registration route not verified; mostly images.

title: Twitter/X Information Operations archive
creator: Twitter/X
license_terms: Application + data agreement for unhashed data (per citing paper)
real_world_eligibility: Real platform data of state-backed operations
inclusion_reason: Needs institutional application; current availability unverified. Campaign table left empty.

title: Pushshift Telegram dataset
creator: Baumgartner et al.
real_world_eligibility: Real public Telegram channel messages
inclusion_reason: Availability and terms not verified.

title: TikTok Research API (2024 US election videos, Luceri et al.)
creator: Luceri et al.
license_terms: Approved academic researchers only (per vendor blog; unverified)
real_world_eligibility: Real platform data
inclusion_reason: Requires institutional API approval.

title: VideoSham
creator: Adobe Research
real_world_eligibility: Real edited videos
inclusion_reason: Its 352 edited videos are already part of ANAKIN (RW-02).

title: HMDB51
creator: Kuehne et al.
license_terms: Authors label dataset CC BY 4.0; clips mostly from movies (rights of footage not cleared)
real_world_eligibility: Movie footage, action classes
inclusion_reason: Underlying movie footage rights not cleared; no relationship labels.

title: UCF101
creator: Soomro et al.
license_terms: Conflicting third-party statements (CC0 / non-commercial / unknown); official terms not found
real_world_eligibility: YouTube action videos
inclusion_reason: Licence unresolved; no relationship labels.

title: Kinetics
creator: Kay et al.
license_terms: Conflicting: CC BY 4.0 (secondary catalogue) vs not specified/uploader rights (a 2026 paper's appendix)
real_world_eligibility: YouTube action clips
inclusion_reason: Licence conflict; links only; no relationship labels.

title: NewsCLIPpings
creator: Luo, Darrell, Rohrbach
real_world_eligibility: Real news images re-paired with captions by an algorithm (constructed mismatches)
inclusion_reason: Images, with algorithmically constructed mismatches; not video lineage.

title: Datasets for coordinated behaviour (Pacheco 2021, Nizzoli 2021, Indiana coordinated-reply datasheet)
creator: Various
real_world_eligibility: Real posts, no video lineage
inclusion_reason: Not verified; Twitter-era data; no video lineage.

title: A dataset of Covid-related misinformation videos and their spread on social media
creator: Knuutila, A.
real_world_eligibility: Eligible: real YouTube videos removed for false COVID information, with the Twitter/Facebook posts that shared them
native_labels: removed by YouTube for false information (dataset-defined), removal/publish timestamps, channel_id, Twitter/Facebook post ids, engagement counts
media_origin_characterization: Videos circulating on YouTube and shared on Twitter/Facebook (Nov 2019 - Jun 2020)
overlap_with: possible YouTube overlap with FVC/FIVR/VCSL (mapped by platform id)
inclusion_reason: Real post-level spread evidence (257k Twitter post ids, 81k Facebook post ids, platform removal times) for the source/post timeline; sharer accounts are NOT provided, so it cannot support coordination claims.
tasks_supported: Module 6 (post timeline), Module 7 (insufficient alone), Phase 2 timeline evidence
limitations: no sharer accounts; publish/removal timestamps present only for part of the videos; Twitter time derived from the post-id snowflake; videos not provided
